tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background of the console. A cool grey-blue tint instead of white, to cut glare at a bright front desk and let white cards stand out.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, drawers, the top bar and inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: the arrival-window lane, table header rows, the doctor column header.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Never the only thing that carries meaning (under 3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, the dashed outline of a held booking, free arrival-window places, the off state of the desk switch. 3.8:1 on surface, 3.4:1 on canvas, 3.1:1 on surface-sunken and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, surface-sunken and neutral-soft (13:1 or more). Also text on an attention fill (7.4:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: patient IDs, ages, timestamps, captions. On canvas 6.2:1, surface 7:1, surface-sunken 5.7:1, neutral-soft 5.7:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The interactive colour: primary buttons, links, selected tabs, taken arrival-window places. As text on canvas 6.7:1, surface 7.6:1, accent-soft 6.1:1.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, the current arrival window, the info badge background. Text on it is accent or ink.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or accent-strong fill (7.6:1 and 10.4:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the surface colour, then a solid 3px ring. 6.7:1 on canvas, 7.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links. An alias of accent.

tokens.name: emergency
tokens.usage: Emergencies only: the emergency banner, P1 marks, an overdue P1 callback. Used as a SOLID fill with on-emergency text, or as text on surface (6.6:1) and emergency-soft (5.6:1). Never for priority visits, errors in forms or decoration.

tokens.name: emergency-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an acknowledged emergency alert in the alerts list, behind emergency text.

tokens.name: on-emergency
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an emergency fill (6.6:1).

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Fill for things that need a look soon: a doctor running 20+ minutes late, a P2 callback mark. Always carries ink text or an attention-ink icon on it; never a thin mark on its own (2.2:1 on surface).

tokens.name: attention-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons for attention states: fee due, schedule-only estimate, due soon, failed message. On attention-soft 6.6:1, surface 7.5:1.

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Background of attention badges and banners, behind attention-ink text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Small marks for done or healthy states: the live dot on a doctor chip, a filled progress segment (4.3:1 on surface). Not used as a large fill.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons for done, paid, with doctor, live. On ok-soft 6.4:1, surface 7.6:1.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of done and paid badges. Kept light on purpose: next to the solid emergency fill it differs by 5.6:1 in lightness, so the two never rely on red against green.

tokens.name: priority
tokens.usage: Paid priority visits: the priority badge text, the priority place in an arrival window (a circle, so it differs from the square regular places by shape as well as hue), the card border. As text on surface 7.6:1 and priority-soft 6.3:1. Never red: a priority visit is a product, not an alarm.

tokens.name: priority-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the priority badge and of an unsold priority place.

tokens.name: on-priority
tokens.usage: Text on a priority fill (7.6:1).

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of neutral badges: booked, any doctor, via agent, walk-in. Text on it is ink or ink-muted.

families.deva: "Anek Devanagari", "Anek Latin", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles and the next patient's name on the doctor view.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and column headers, the emergency banner title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Wants to be seen today; nothing free after 6 pm.
styles.usage: Default text in the console: reasons, transcript lines, descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Patient and doctor names, the planned time of an arrival window.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, chips, buttons in dense rows, table headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Patient IDs, ages, timestamps, helper text under inputs.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Big numbers: delay on a doctor column, counts on the day summary. Always with tabular figures.

styles.name: call-next
styles.usage: The label of the doctor's Call next button only.

styles.name: hi-body
styles.sample: आज ही दिखाना है; शाम 6 बजे के बाद जगह नहीं।
styles.usage: Hindi counterpart of body. One pixel larger and much taller lines, so matras above and below the headline never touch.

styles.name: hi-label
styles.usage: Hindi counterpart of label. No letter-spacing: it breaks the headline (shirorekha).

styles.name: hi-call-next
styles.usage: Hindi counterpart of call-next, for the doctor's Call next button only. Slightly smaller than call-next because Hindi labels run longer; may wrap to two lines inside the button.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; between badge rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges and chips; padding inside badges (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside patient cards and table cells; gap between cards in a window.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside panels and drawers; gap between doctor columns; the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a screen; the page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a screen title; around the doctor view's Call next button.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large empty states and the sign-in screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, arrival-window places, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, patient cards, chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, drawers, the emergency banner, the Call next button.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The staff-on-desk switch track and thumb, and status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Patient cards and the top bar: just enough lift off the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Drawers, menus and the emergency banner, which sit above everything else.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs on the desktop console.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of buttons on phones and in the emergency banner.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target on phones, including small icon buttons.

tokens.name: call-next
tokens.usage: Height of the doctor's Call next button.

tokens.name: place
tokens.usage: Side of one place square in an arrival window.
